title: Memory Visualization UX for Templates and Instances
description: Add rich memory visualization views to both template and instance screens in the UI app. For templates: display a clear mapping of which steps read from or write to which memory files, giving template authors visibility into the memory flow across the process. For instances: show the same step-to-memory mapping plus deeper runtime details — current memory file contents, change history per step execution, diffs between memory states, and which step last modified each memory topic. The goal is to make memory a first-class, easily explorable part of the process UX rather than a hidden implementation detail.
author: matanha@payoneer.com
